output.evaluation_note: The English sense 'results, record, grades' refers to performance or achievement data. Japanese '記録' (kiroku) covers this sense well, as noted in its gloss ('best performance/record'), although it also has broader meanings (e.g., written account, log). Vietnamese 'thành tích' is an excellent match for 'achievement' or 'performance record'. While its definition mentions 'good results', 'thành tích' is commonly used for performance in general (e.g., 'thành tích học tập' - academic record, which can be good or bad). All expressions are natural and align well for the intended pedagogical sense.
